name: Agent Skills tab: link toggles, category labels and drag handles
description: Read-only: opens the seeded Test Quality Reviewer's Skills tab and checks that every skill has a link toggle (role switch) and a category label, that the four linked, enabled skills are draggable while unlinked ones are not, and that the arrow buttons remain. Nothing is dragged, linked or saved, and no model is called.

steps.label: open the seeded Test Quality Reviewer

cmd: drag an enabled skill to reorder
steps.label: the hint mentions drag-and-drop

cmd: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=agent-skill-]')]; const on = rows.filter((r) => r.querySelector('[role=switch]')?.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true'); return rows.length >= 4 && rows.every((r) => r.querySelector('[role=switch]')) && on.length === 4 && on.every((r) => r.getAttribute('draggable') === 'true') && rows.filter((r) => !on.includes(r)).every((r) => r.getAttribute('draggable') === 'false') && !document.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]'); })()
steps.label: every skill has a toggle; exactly the linked, enabled ones are draggable
arrow buttons remain for keyboard reordering
